summary.intent: Determine whether the Release workflow failed on the latest merges to main, and fix it if so.
summary.outcome: Confirmed the Release and CI workflows failed on the last two merges at the 'Verify release candidate' gate (E0063 missing field `style` in a `ChangelogInput` initializer) because #473 and #474 conflicted only in combination. Opened signed PR #477 with a one-line fix (`style: Default::default()`); local checks pass and it awaits review.

repo: Release workflow runs on main pushes and gates on 'Verify release candidate'; when it fails, artifact build, execute and release PR refresh are skipped, so nothing is half-published (release PR #468 just isn't refreshed).

The main ruleset (repo orin-dx/callisto) has no required status checks (`required_status_checks: []`), so the merge queue doesn't require CI. PR checks run once on the PR head, so a stale PR can merge with an old green.
Local verification commands for this repo: `just pre-push`, lint, doc-check, test, and two workflow contract scripts.
Commits in this repo are expected to be signed; verification can be checked via `gh api repos/orin-dx/callisto/commits/<sha> --jq .commit.verification.reason`.
workflow: Two PRs can each pass CI and merge textually clean but break together when one adds a required struct field and the other adds a literal constructing that struct. Apply known cross-PR fixes to the PR before it merges, not as a follow-up note.
Verify a PR's CI-green claim against current main, since green on a stale head does not guarantee green after merge.
`gh pr edit --body-file` with a temp file is a clean way to update a PR title and body, and it can be combined with `gh api` calls to check signature verification and rulesets.

friction: Merge-order interaction between #473 and #474 broke main, and the fix was recorded as a note but not applied before both PRs merged.
The ruleset lacks required status checks, so nothing blocked the broken merges.
open_items: Merge #477 and confirm the Release workflow goes green and release PR #468 refreshes.
Consider requiring CI status checks in the main ruleset; this is the user's setting and was not changed.
Remaining labels work and the preview path rule come after the fix lands.
